name: Vanta
description: Vanta automates SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, and 25+ other frameworks. Its AI features include Vanta AI for control mapping, evidence collection, and questionnaire automation — drafting answers to security reviews from your existing policies and reducing manual work for security and GRC teams.
